additional_concerns: The legacy exclusions in nodes 1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83, 4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e, ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94 and ea4d19630f8cab09065b1909 convert preservation of an application process into substantive unavailability of relief. Node 4d548f2e09bc36ef51212f64 excludes legacy applications from its question rather than deciding their eligibility. Its OUT_OF_SCOPE result must not be treated as denial of relief.

The specific commencement date supports assessment from 28 November 2025, but the introductory immediate-effect language and the legally relevant assessment event warrant clarification. Node 4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e must not equate assessment date with implementation date without further authority.
The circular does not expressly impose item (i)'s home-supervision condition on item (ii). Adding that separate condition would require justification.

Home compliance and classifications of novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications remain supplied judgments. Applying them to a concrete change requires applicable home-jurisdiction rules and relevant SFC guidance, neither supplied here.
The two missing dependency IDs have no supplied mapping to named external materials. No catalogue match is inferred.
Passing these predicates does not establish notification, filing or post-vetting compliance, legal approval, or the complete underlying approval obligation.
